title: Vector and matrix monotonicity characterisation of the "load forces" in nonlinear elasticity: compressible versus incompressible response
summary: In this paper, we study the relation between different notions of monotonicity for isotropic hyperelastic compressible and incompressible materials. We study how to define the monotonicity concept on the manifold $\rm{Sym}^{++}(n)\cap \rm{SL}(n)$ of positive definite symmetric tensors with unit determinant and the corresponding spectral manifold $\mathcal S=\left\{(λ_1,\dotsc,λ_n)\in \mathbb{R}^n_+\,\middle|\, λ_1λ_2\cdotsλ_n=1\right\}$, and give a precise characterisation of monotonicity in the case of hyperelastic materials.
